label: Cold War Files
titel: The Bomb That Almost Went Off

szenen.text: A B-52 bomber broke apart over *North Carolina.*
Each was hundreds of times stronger than *Hiroshima.*
One bomb's parachute opened. It hung from a *tree.*
Several safety steps had already failed.
A safety expert wrote this in a *1969 report.*
The report was declassified, and published in *2013.*
How many more close calls were there? *Follow.*

caption: A 1961 bomber crash nearly detonated a hydrogen bomb on U.S. soil. Did you know this? AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels.

story_frage: In 1961, one switch stopped a U.S. hydrogen bomb from detonating.
